{{Quote|Ten years ago, the colony was attacked by the Sith. My family was killed. They never fought back. The Sith crushed them, the way you might step on a bug.|Fideltin Rusk|audio=Rusk2.flac|<ref name="Passive Resistance" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3650 BBY/Legends|3650 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]],<ref name="Passive Resistance" /> the latter '''attacked''' a [[Chagrian colony|colony]] of [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] pacifists<ref name="Holonet" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The colony, which included the [[Fideltin Rusk's mother|mother]] and [[Fideltin Rusk's father|father]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]], refused to fight back against anyone who attempted to take advantage of them, and the Sith Empire destroyed the defenseless colony with ease.<ref name="Passive Resistance" /> The [[Death/Legends|death]] of his family greatly affected Rusk, driving him to become reckless with the lives of the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] under his [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]].<ref name="Holonet" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on Mindor was first mentioned in Fideltin Rusk's entry on [[The Holonet]], a section of the [https://www.swtor.com official website] for the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="Holonet" /> which was released in [[2011]].<ref name="Passive Resistance" />
